items.title: Christian McBride interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 12, 1996
items.q: I’d do my solo piece and the stuff with Ray Brown and Milt Hinton on the last day.

ctx.x: Really. You’ve got “Night Train” on there and I said all right, “Night Train.” A classic blues thing. I was wondering, like how is he going to do this? And it’s just bass, right?

Yeah. Every time I think about how I did it I get tired. Because I did the same thing on the new album as I did on “Getting To It.” The producer said, “Well you know why don’t you feature yourself on something, you know, just unaccompanied bass?” I said well sometimes — this is not a good habit — sometimes it works out and sometimes it doesn’t, but I tend to wait until the last minute to do some things. So things get so backed up and sometimes I don’t get to things until the last minute. So I didn’t really think…
